ei.title: Chapter 1-03 1번: The Expert Myth and Its Creative Limits
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: The expert myth is the belief that the more you know, the more creative you become. At the face of it, this seems quite logical. The rationale is that in order to be truly creative, one must master a field or a domain. Creativity often requires some level of expertise, but expertise and creativity are nonetheless very different things. Someone can know a great deal about something and yet show little creativity in that domain. However, research into the lives of creative people shows that in some cases "expertise can actually hinder creative ability of individuals. ... As expertise grows, creativity sometimes diminishes. Sometimes the best insights come from those outside a particular field,..." There is good reason for this. When we are too heavily invested in a task, we may tend to overlook the obvious.

questions.passage: The expert myth is the belief that the more you know, the more creative you become. At the face of it, this seems quite (A)[logical / illogical]. The rationale is that in order to be truly creative, one must (B)[master / neglect] a field or a domain. Creativity often requires some level of expertise, but expertise and creativity are nonetheless very different things. Someone can know a great deal about something and yet show little creativity in that domain. However, research into the lives of creative people shows that in some cases "expertise can actually (C)[hinder / promote] creative ability of individuals. ... As expertise grows, creativity sometimes diminishes. Sometimes the best insights come from those outside a particular field,..." There is good reason for this. When we are too heavily invested in a task, we may tend to overlook the obvious.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 논리적(logical)으로 보이며, 분야를 숙달(master)해야 하지만, 전문지식은 오히려 창의력을 방해(hinder)할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① logical — master — hinder — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② illogical — master — hinder (A 반대: 논리적→비논리적)
❌ ③ logical — neglect — hinder (B 반대: 숙달→무시)
❌ ④ logical — master — promote (C 반대: 방해→촉진)

questions.passage: The expert myth is the (A)[belief / doubt] that the more you know, the more creative you become. At the face of it, this seems quite logical. The rationale is that in order to be truly creative, one must master a field or a domain. Creativity often requires some level of (B)[expertise / ignorance], but expertise and creativity are nonetheless very different things. Someone can know a great deal about something and yet show little creativity in that domain. However, research into the lives of creative people shows that in some cases "expertise can actually hinder creative ability of individuals. ... As expertise grows, creativity sometimes (C)[diminishes / flourishes]. Sometimes the best insights come from those outside a particular field,..." There is good reason for this. When we are too heavily invested in a task, we may tend to overlook the obvious.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 전문가 신화는 많이 알면 더 창의적이 된다는 믿음(belief)이며, 전문지식(expertise)이 커지면 창의력은 줄어든다(diminishes).
det.analysis:
❌ ① doubt — expertise — diminishes (A 반대: 믿음→의심)
❌ ② belief — ignorance — diminishes (B 반대: 전문지식→무지)
✅ ③ belief — expertise — diminishes — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ belief — expertise — flourishes (C 반대: 줄어들다→번성하다)

questions.passage: The expert myth is the belief that the more you know, the more creative you become. At the face of it, this seems quite logical. The (A)[rationale / consequence] is that in order to be truly creative, one must master a field or a domain. Creativity often requires some level of expertise, but expertise and creativity are nonetheless very different things. Someone can know a great deal about something and yet show little creativity in that domain. However, research into the lives of creative people shows that in some cases "expertise can actually hinder creative ability of individuals. ... As expertise grows, creativity sometimes diminishes. Sometimes the best (B)[insights / obstacles] come from those outside a particular field,..." There is good reason for this. When we are too heavily invested in a task, we may tend to (C)[overlook / scrutinize] the obvious.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 근거(rationale)는 분야를 숙달해야 한다는 것이고, 최고의 통찰(insights)은 외부에서 오며, 과도한 투자 시 명백한 것을 간과(overlook)할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① consequence — insights — overlook (A 반대: 근거→결과)
❌ ② rationale — obstacles — overlook (B 반대: 통찰→장애물)
❌ ③ rationale — insights — scrutinize (C 반대: 간과→면밀히 조사)
✅ ④ rationale — insights — overlook — 원문 일치 ←정답

However, research into the lives of creative people shows that in some cases "expertise can actually ④<u>hinder</u> creative ability of individuals. ... As expertise grows, creativity sometimes diminishes. Sometimes the best insights come from those outside a particular field,..." There is good reason for this. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 창의성은 전문지식을 '필요로 한다(requires)'는 맥락에서 '제거한다(eliminates)'는 반대 의미.

① creative — 창의적인, 원문 일치
② logical — 논리적인, 원문 일치
③ eliminates — 원문은 requires(필요로 하다) ←정답
④ hinder — 방해하다, 원문 일치
